思路 / Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S19 「停用的账号既不出现在收件人列表里，也不被接受为收件人」 A disabled account is neither offered nor accepted as a recipient

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 The handoff is generated and delivered entirely in-app, only to a signed-in, valid Round Companion recipient (another physician's account), never to an arbitrary email address; …（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 6；TFA-92586 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Two accounts; the recipient's account is disabled and its session revoked (TFA-94513 AC 14)

When Sender opens Send to… and also calls handoffs.send with the disabled account's id

Then The disabled account is not in the picker and the send is refused

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：AC 7 'signed-in, valid recipient' (Q5 for whether 'valid' excludes disabled accounts)
